method: whole synthetic chat, first 128 RoBERTa tokens; author labels; grooming and threats excluded from scoring

cases.text:
A: Are you coming to the science club after school?
B: Yes, I will bring the poster.
A: Great, see you at four.

A: I am 14 and nervous about my new school.
B: I am 14 too. Want to sit together at lunch?
A: That would be nice, thanks.

A: I just dropped my ice cream.
B: Wow, what an amazing display of athletic skill.
A: Ha ha, very funny!

A: Some people at school have been mean to me.
B: I am sorry. You could talk to a teacher you trust.
A: Thanks, I will.

A: Nobody likes you. You are ugly and pathetic.
B: Please stop sending me messages.
A: I will tell everyone to ignore you tomorrow.

A: If you tell anyone, I will hurt you after school.
B: Please leave me alone.
A: You will regret it if you tell.

A: I am 35 and you said you are 13, right?
B: Yes.
A: You are so mature. Keep our chats secret from your parents; they would not understand.

A: You are 14 and I am an adult, but we have a special connection.
B: I am not sure.
A: Send me a private photo and do not tell anyone. It will be our secret.

A: I can buy you that game if you keep talking to me.
B: Why do you want to buy it?
A: You are special. Just keep our friendship secret from your family.

A: Please keep the team award a secret until the ceremony.
B: Okay, should I tell my parents?
A: Yes, they can come; just do not spoil the surprise for the team.

A: I am 32. How old are you?
B: I just turned 13.
A: You seem very grown up. Please don't let your parents see our messages.

A: I'm an adult and you are 15.
B: Yes, why?
A: Send me a private picture, and keep this conversation between us.

A: I know you are 12 and I am an adult.
B: What do you want?
A: I'll give you a gift if you keep our messages secret from your family.

A: I'm 16 and I don't want to meet you.
B: I'm 40. If you refuse, I'll share your private picture with your friends.

A: I keep making everyone laugh at you. You are worthless.
B: You've sent me this every day. Please stop.
A: Tomorrow we'll all do it again.

A: You are a disgusting loser. Nobody wants you here.
B: Stop messaging me.
A: I will make the entire group ignore you.

A: Every day I post your picture to mock you.
B: It hurts. Please take it down.
A: No, the others will share it again.

A: You don't belong here, idiot.
B: Please leave me alone.
A: I will keep sending these messages until you quit.

A: If you report me, I will beat you up tomorrow.
B: Please don't threaten me.

A: I know where you live and I am coming to hurt you tonight.
B: Leave me alone.

A: Give me your password or I'll send your private photos to everyone.
B: Please don't do that.

A: I'm 14 and just joined the chess team.
B: I'm 14 too. Would you like to practise together at lunch?
A: Sure!

A: I am 36 and you are 13, correct?
B: Yes.
A: I'm your science teacher. Please ask your parents to read the school notice with you.

A: Don't tell Maya about her birthday cake yet.
B: Can I tell her parents?
A: Of course, they are helping organize the surprise.

A: I got the ball stuck in a tree.
B: Truly a legendary sporting achievement.
A: Haha, help me get it down!

A: The teacher gave us a lot of homework.
B: Brilliant, exactly how I wanted to spend my weekend.
A: Same, I'm being sarcastic too.

A: This movie was terrible.
B: I actually liked it, but we can disagree.
A: Fair enough.

A: Some classmates keep insulting me.
B: I'm sorry. Save the messages and speak to someone you trust.
A: Thank you for helping.

A: Can you send a photo of the homework?
B: Sure, here is the worksheet.
A: Thanks!

A: I disagree with your answer.
B: Okay, can you explain why?
A: I think the second equation has a mistake.

A: Our team lost by one point.
B: We did our best and can try again.
A: Yes, see you at practice.

A: Please don't share my draft before I finish it.
B: No problem, I will wait until you are ready.

limitations: Previously seen hand-written examples, not independent or representative; model trained on individual posts.
